run_texify_app: run the texify_app_cli to launch the Streamlit LaTeX OCR web application
build_pdf_page_image: build a function that renders a PDF page at high DPI as a PIL image for OCR processing
test_page_counter: test the page_counter function that counts the number of pages in a PDF file
refactor_inference: refactor the inference function to perform LaTeX OCR on a cropped image region given bounding box coordinates
summarize_replace_fences: summarize the replace_fences function that converts HTML math tags to LaTeX delimiters
